answer_1.quote: We use Large Language Models (LLM) and Vision-Language Models (VLM) to label several aspects of the text and image from news articles, including generic, issue-specific framing and the topic of the article.
answer_1.outputs: generic frames, issue-specific frames, topics, main subjects, image captions

answer_2.quote: Our model received a micro averaged F1 score of 0.5, with an averaged precision of 0.42 and averaged recall of 0.62.

answer_4.quote: Two of the authors (graduate students between the ages of 28-35) of this study manually annotated 600 images for generic frames across a stratified (time-period and topics) sample of the dataset.
answer_4.guideline: We use annotation guidelines released by , adapting them to the image annotation setting with examples of images for each framing category.
